english.title: Sell / transfer prohibited weapon - a rocket launcher
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the authority of the Secretary of State, sold or transferred a rocket launcher for projecting a stabilised missile, other than a launcher designed for line-throwing or pyrotechnic purposes or as a signalling apparatus
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1)(ae) of, and Schedule 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See offence wordings: H6113, H6114, H6115, H6117, H6118, H6119 and H6120.
(ii) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).

other.penalty:
Indictment: maximum 10 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

A minimum sentence may apply to this offence, see section 311 of, and Schedule 20 to, the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
